verdict: Independent source review and direct inspection of six retained primary ARM HAL archives, 21 linked firmware ELFs, their actual Cargo JSON, HAL build-script output and selected generated inputs support main runtime acceptance. The 21 separately retained dependency HAL archives are not additional standalone commands. Source-data checks passed in documented segments after narrow checker schema corrections. Final source-only clean replay remains separate and pending.

retained_failed_source_gate_attempts.reason: The appended native-four source check first assumed a vendor-lock child id field. It was corrected to bind the actual parent source identity.
A later comparison treated clock narrative notes as hardware projection fields. It was corrected to explicitly compare every hardware field while retaining exact key and value checks.

The native SVD reader assumed bitOffset/bitWidth for every field. L052 contains paired lsb/msb encodings; the correction decodes that exact alternate representation while preserving name, offset, width and completeness comparisons.

post_main_checker_correction.timing: The parent-source identity and clock-field projection fixes were present before the main build freeze (checker9d749aa5584a7a229cabe9230e712d3ef9332259cf66570db6ec991b17b42ee1). Only the final SVD field-encoding parser correction was applied after the main build (checker77c4591). It does not change HAL or example code. The seven source-data commands passed in their documented segments; final clean replay must rebuild and recheck the complete final source tree.

static_review.residual: All existing HAL bodies match Stage84 after only approved build additions, two lib cfg expansions, six CH3/CH4 geometry cfg expansions, full-line comments and blank lines are removed. Other83 existing HAL inputs, including SPI, remain byte-identical.

ownership_and_contract_findings.build_qualification: Accepted: exact 11/four generic roster; scalar native IR and typed descriptors, IRQ topology, memory, RCC, TX selectors/endpoint checks; own L052 UART/SYSCTRL version distinct. Old F020 qualification, five-channel branch, request cardinality/distinctness, RX subset and pair filters preserved.
ownership_and_contract_findings.startup_and_revocation: Accepted: init gates before descriptor inspection, retains dirty gate, excludes retained/gated requests under documented normal reset/clean runtime; no fresh snapshot upgrades Raw. Admission claimed before vector enable; rejection does not mutate registers or IRQ enable.
ownership_and_contract_findings.copy_ownership: Accepted: exclusive static full SRAM ranges, sealed widths, count/alignment/address/nonoverlap validation before launch, Running/fence before EN; only recorded clean TC without TE plus STATUS5/SOFTSRC0 returns owners. Error/forget preserve reservation; error forgets Transfer; Drop may block indefinitely.
ownership_and_contract_findings.uart_ownership: Accepted: baud/stage checked before admitted channel and UART setup. Private static stage receives CPU copies, InFlight installed before start, EN before DMATX, clean TC/STATUS before request close and retirement. Write/flush reap retained chunk; error permanently quarantines; pending Drop preserves config/pin/stage/channel/request/clocks.
ownership_and_contract_findings.isolation: Accepted: UART code/cfg unchanged after full-line comments removed; Info prepare, ring detach, RXIDLE guards, no-ring RX DMA errors, lifecycle pre-MMIO inactive check and wake-after-lock preserved. Ordinary/buffered TX starts dma None. SPI source byte-identical; CH5 strict dma_v1; public hardware new_read/new_write strict cw32x030.
ownership_and_contract_findings.unsafe_api_correction: Accepted factual listing: raw Channel::new, unsafe Transfer::new_copy and unsafe OwnedCopy::new remain exposed wherever DMA module selected, including F020/four-family cohort. Public new_read/new_write remain x030-only. Their error/forget hardware exclusivity contracts are retained, with no stop/drain proof added.
ownership_and_contract_findings.shared_vector: Accepted: independent Running-state gate precedes MMIO; CH2 and CH3 each observe/clear only their terminal bits, TE wins, other-channel flags remain one in ICR seed. Wake occurs after critical section. No DMA clock reset/off or global NVIC unpend introduced.

static_review.example_findings: Actual source inspected. Four immediate copy calls precede awaits; same returned owners reused only after success. Separate stages/UARTs/pins/channels, flash85 and local41 byte caller buffers, flush, exact F8 and L052 cfgs.

inspection_method: Read actual compiler messages and retained bytes. Independently parse ARM ELF headers, symbols, vector words, allocated sections and load segments; inspect archive members; compare HAL cfgs, selected memory, channel IRQ mapping, request traits and safe pin traits. Recorder pass flags are not used as evidence.
limitations: No target or board execution was performed.
Generic HAL builds demonstrate the None SRAM projection and API compilation; no runtime rejection was executed.
Linked vectors and static ownership analysis do not establish hardware transfer, error-time bus drain, worst-case stack use, throughput or finite cancellation.
Drop may block indefinitely; error and forget retain resources. No new stop/drain proof is introduced.
Final source-only clean replay is not credited by this main review.
